```yaml
name: Ampcode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches:
      - main
      - staging

# Cancel previous runs for the same PR and branch
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ampcode-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # Matrix strategy for potential future expansion or parallel processing chunks
        # Currently single job per PR, but structured for scalability
        node-version: [18]
      max-parallel: 3

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Fetch all history for proper diff analysis

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp
          amp --version

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
        with:
          # Filter for common code file types
          files: |
            **/*.ts
            **/*.tsx
            **/*.js
            **/*.jsx
            **/*.py
            **/*.java
            **/*.go
            **/*.rs
            **/*.cpp
            **/*.c
            **/*.h
            **/*.css
            **/*.scss
            **/*.html
          max_files: 50

      - name: Run Ampcode Review
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        env:
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          CHANGED_FILES: ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}
        run: |
          # Create a temporary file with the list of changed files
          echo "$CHANGED_FILES" > changed_files.txt
          
          # Run ampcode review on the changed files
          # Assuming ampcode CLI supports a command like 'review' or 'analyze'
          # Adjust the command based on actual @sourcegraph/amp CLI documentation
          amp review \
            --files changed_files.txt \
            --pr-number $PR_NUMBER \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --base-ref ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} \
            --head-ref ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} \
            --output-format json \
            --output-file review_results.json || true

      - name: Post Review Comments
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true' && always()
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # Check if review results exist
          if [ -f review_results.json ]; then
            # Parse and post comments using GitHub API
            # This script assumes the JSON output from ampcode contains structured comments
            # Adjust the jq queries based on actual ampcode output structure
            
            # Example: Extract comments and post them
            # Note: This is a simplified example. Actual implementation depends on ampcode output format
            cat review_results.json | jq -r '.comments[] | "## Review Comment\n\n**File:** \(.file)\n**Line:** \(.line)\n**Message:** \(.message)\n\n---"' > comments.md
            
            if [ -s comments.md ]; then
              # Post the comments as a PR review comment
              gh pr comment $PR_NUMBER --body-file comments.md
            else
              echo "No comments generated by Ampcode."
            fi
          else
            echo "No review results found. Skipping comment posting."
          fi

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -f changed_files.txt review_results.json comments.md
```
